<mxfile host="app.diagrams.net" scale="1" border="0"> <diagram id="va9UVNANkAM7rqn8irZz" name="Page-2"> <mxGraphModel dx="3664" dy="2136" grid="0" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "%% Relational diagram sau chuẩn hóa 3NF
%% Nguồn: normalized_schema.md §6.2 và DDL §8
erDiagram
 region ||--o{ city : \"gồm\"
 region ||--o{ district : \"gồm\"
 city ||--o{ zip_area : \"chứa\"
 district ||--o{ zip_area : \"chứa\"
 zip_area ||--o{ customer : \"cư trú\"

 product_model ||--o{ product : \"biến thể\"
 review_title_label ||--o{ review : \"nhãn\"

 customer ||--o{ order : \"đặt\"
 order ||--|{ order_item : \"gồm\"
 order ||--|| payment : \"thanh toán\"
 order ||--o| shipment : \"giao\"
 product ||--o{ order_item : \"được bán\"

 order_item ||--o{ order_item_promotion : \"áp dụng\"
 promotion ||--o{ order_item_promotion : \"áp dụng\"

 order_item ||--o| product_return : \"bị trả\"
 order_item ||--o| review : \"được đánh giá\"

 product ||--o{ inventory_snapshot : \"tồn kho\"

 region {
 string region PK
 }

 city {
 string city PK
 string region FK
 }

 district {
 string district PK
 string region FK
 }

 zip_area {
 int zip PK
 string city FK
 string district FK
 }

 customer {
 int customer_id PK
 int zip FK
 string gender
 string age_group
 string acquisition_channel
 date signup_date \"KHONG dang tin\"
 }

 product_model {
 string product_name PK
 string category
 string segment
 }

 product {
 int product_id PK
 string product_name FK
 string size
 string color
 decimal list_price \"snapshot hien tai\"
 decimal unit_cogs
 }

 promotion {
 string promo_id PK
 string promo_name UK
 string promo_type
 decimal discount_value
 date start_date
 date end_date
 string applicable_category
 string promo_channel
 boolean stackable_flag
 int min_order_value
 }

 order {
 int order_id PK
 date order_date
 int customer_id FK
 string order_status
 string payment_method
 string device_type
 string order_source
 }

 order_item {
 int order_id PK, FK
 int line_number PK
 int product_id FK
 int quantity
 decimal unit_price \"gia TAI THOI DIEM BAN\"
 decimal discount_amount
 }

 order_item_promotion {
 int order_id PK, FK
 int line_number PK, FK
 string promo_id PK, FK
 }

 payment {
 int order_id PK, FK
 int installments
 }

 shipment {
 int order_id PK, FK
 date ship_date
 date delivery_date
 decimal shipping_fee
 }

 product_return {
 string return_id PK
 int order_id FK
 int line_number FK
 date return_date
 string return_reason
 int return_quantity
 decimal refund_amount
 }

 review_title_label {
 string review_title PK
 int rating
 }

 review {
 string review_id PK
 int order_id FK
 int line_number FK
 date review_date
 string review_title FK
 }

 inventory_snapshot {
 date snapshot_date PK
 int product_id PK, FK
 int stock_on_hand
 int units_received
 int units_sold
 int stockout_days
 }

 web_traffic {
 date traffic_date PK
 int sessions
 int unique_visitors
 int page_views
 decimal bounce_rate
 decimal avg_session_duration_sec
 string traffic_source
 }

 daily_sales_forecast {
 date forecast_date PK
 decimal revenue
 decimal cogs
 }
